fusions.name: Dive Crush
fusions.desc: A falling blow lands on the first enemy it meets, dealing 36 blunt damage, and 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Flattening Rap
fusions.desc: A knocking blow deals 8 blunt damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Anvil Hang
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 4 health.

fusions.name: Cracking Habit
fusions.desc: Your blunt attacks ignore 20% of the target's armour. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.
